# Blueprint

> A person's reasoning written as a tree of topics, each claim checked by Lean: shapes and rules for the claim, the statement a person audits and the guidance that returns, each with its grade of evidence, and checks to run in CI.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension.

## Standard

- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/standard.md): the one-page card to follow, with every principle and its grade
- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository

## Statement: what the person audits

- [One claim, one declaration](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/principles/statement/one-claim-one-declaration.md): a claim names exactly one Lean declaration, that declaration exists, and no declaration serves two claims.
- [A short statement, apart from its proof](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/principles/statement/short-statement-apart-from-proof.md): the Lean statement a person audits sits in a short file of its own, apart from every proof, and each proof is held to it.
- [The model decides nothing](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/principles/statement/the-model-decides-nothing.md): the person audits the statement that was checked, never a repaired one, and a model's reading of a statement is labelled as a model's, apart from the person's audit.

## Claim: what the person writes

- [Guidance at the claim's grain](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/principles/claim/guidance-at-the-claims-grain.md): a verdict, an error or a hint names the person's claim, not the checker's internal step.
- [The person splits the reasoning](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/principles/claim/the-person-splits-the-reasoning.md): each claim is one topic the person wrote, with one sentence, a statement and a proof; the splitting into claims is not left to a model.

## Optional

- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/evidence/README.md): one literature review per topic, with the evidence against
- [Bibliography](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/evidence/bibliography.md): every cited work, once
- [Shapes](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/shapes/README.md): skeletons for kinds of documents
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-blueprint/decisions/README.md): the choices this repository made, one record each
